user.title: Freebox
user.description:
Please enter your Freebox details.
You can check this link to obtain the values: {api_url}

data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of your Freebox router.

link.title: Link Freebox router
link.description: Select **Submit**, then touch the right arrow on the router to register Freebox with Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authorize Freebox
reauth_confirm.description: The Freebox token expired or is missing. Select **Submit**, then press the right arrow on the Freebox Server.

permission.title: Permission is required
permission.description: Open {accounts_url} and grant the access policy: "Gestion de l'alarme et maison connectée".

lan_options.title: LAN clients
lan_options.description:
Choose this **before** Home Assistant lists devices. Freebox Server, repeaters and Home devices (alarm, PIR, cameras, shutters) are always created.

« Create devices for network clients » is off by default (Home Assistant rule: a device tracker does not create devices); turn it on to file each client under Wired / Wi-Fi network clients.
Uncheck « Track LAN clients » if presence is already handled by another integration.

Players detected: {players}

data_description.track_lan_clients: Phones, PCs and IoT hosts seen by the Freebox.
data_description.create_wifi_sensors: Signal strength in dBm when the client is on Wi-Fi.
data_description.create_lan_devices: Off (default): tracker and RSSI stay standalone entities, linked to another integration's device when one exists. On: one device per client, filed by group.
data_description.home_poll_interval: How often to query PIR, contacts, alarm and shutters. 5 s is closer to the official integration if that one is disabled.
data_description.remote_code: 8 digits from the Player: Settings → System → Information. Extra fields appear per detected Player. Leave empty without a Player, or for Mini 4K / Pop.

error.register_failed: Failed to register, please try again
error.invalid_token: Invalid or expired token. It has been automatically deleted. Press the right arrow button on your Freebox to re-authorize Home Assistant.

general.title: Freebox Homexa options
general.description:
LAN clients are phones, PCs and IoT hosts seen by the Freebox. Freebox Server, repeaters and Home devices are not affected. Since Home Assistant 2026.8, devices are no longer merged across integrations.

Players detected: {players}

data_description.track_lan_clients: Disable this if presence is already handled by another integration.
data_description.create_wifi_sensors: RSSI is added when a client is seen on Wi-Fi, including after the first setup.
data_description.create_lan_devices: On: each client is filed under Network › Amazon, Phones, Computers, TV & media, Smart devices, Consoles, Printers or Other. Off: tracker and RSSI stay standalone entities and existing client devices are removed on reload.
data_description.home_poll_interval: PIR, contacts, alarm and shutters. Disable the official Freebox integration before using 5 s.
data_description.remote_code: 8 digits. On the Player: Settings → System → Information. Used for power, TV and digits. Mini 4K / Pop often use Android TV Remote.

tnt.title: TNT guide
tnt.description: Choose the followed channels. Sensors of unchecked channels are removed. The personal TMDB API key is optional: without it no posters are fetched (no shared key is bundled).

profiles.title: Reminder profiles
profiles.description: Configured profiles: {profiles}. A profile groups a person's name and their own devices to notify.

add_profile.title: Reminder profile
add_profile.description: Name the profile (e.g. Fred) and choose its devices.

groups.title: Device groups
groups.description: {count} Homexa devices. “Automatic” keeps the computed group (shown in brackets); pick a group to force it. Applied on reload (automatic after saving).

types.title: Network client types
types.description: {count} network clients. In “Wired network clients” and “Wi-Fi clients” (box Wi-Fi), each client is placed in a type sub-group: Servers, VMs and containers, Network equipment, Computers… “Automatic” keeps the computed type (shown in brackets); pick a type to force it. Wi-Fi clients of a repeater stay directly under the repeater. Applied on reload (automatic after saving).

repeaters.title: Merge a duplicate repeater

error.no_name: Enter a name for this profile.
error.duplicate_name: A profile with this name already exists.
error.device_conflict: The same device cannot be both a notification target and a voice speaker (it would be announced twice).
error.repeater_same: Pick two different devices: the duplicate and the target repeater.

abort.no_devices: No Homexa device loaded: reload the integration and try again.

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Reload Freebox Homexa, reconnect and rediscover devices.

remote.name: Send remote command
remote.description: Sends remote keys to the Freebox Player, like the Player Remote entity (network remote code from the options).

code.name: Keys
code.description: One key or several separated by commas (e.g. power, or 1,2 for channel 12). Valid keys: power, ok, up, down, left, right, back, home, 0-9, vol_inc, vol_dec, mute, prgm_inc, prgm_dec, play, …

player_id.name: Player
player_id.description: Freebox Player id (1, 2…). Optional with a single Player.

device_id.name: Player device
device_id.description: Homexa Player device to control (alternative to player_id).

schedule_reminder.name: Schedule TNT reminder
schedule_reminder.description: Schedules a reminder (notification and/or voice announcement) before a programme starts.

minutes_before.name: Minutes before
minutes_before.description: Delay before the start (5, 10 or 15 min).

profile_name.name: Profile name
profile_name.description: Reminder profile name (optional if only one profile exists).

entry_not_loaded.message: Cannot run {service}: the targeted Freebox is not loaded.

no_reminder_profile.message: No matching reminder profile: create one in Freebox Homexa → Configure → Reminder profiles (set profile_name if there are several).

reminder_too_late.message: Too late to schedule this reminder: not enough time left before the programme starts.

remote_no_player.message: No Freebox Player detected and no remote code configured.

remote_multiple_players.message: Several Freebox Players: set player_id or device_id (or a shared remote code in the options).
